messages:
Anya: Heads-up — after merging quantize PR #492 I'm seeing a cluster of red markers in the model diff panel for a few eval runs, specifically latency-related. not sure if it's real or a dashboard mapping issue. screenshot attached :thinking_face:
Sam: Can you drop the eval run id? sometimes the UI mixes up metric keys (we had `p95_latency_ms` vs `latency_ms_p95` once).
Anya: run id: eval-2026-03-19-07\.. The spikes show up only for q8_0 variants across convo-quality and summarization tasks.
Leo: On the runner side I see repeated warnings around KV cache timeouts right after the quantize job: `WARN runner: kv-cache fetch timeout for model q8_0 on worker-3, retrying`
Marta: Quick thought — scorecards + diff panel render use the dashboard metric name map (median vs p95). If the alert thresholds use p95 but the chart pulls median, you can get red diffs even when most requests are fine.
Marta: Also the diff panel normalizes units inconsistently (ms vs s) for some older metrics. I can repro locally.
Jordan: I can push a small normalization shim to the dashboard backend: map aliases, normalize units to ms, and add a warning badge when aliasing happened. I'll add a unit test to eval-harness CI to prevent regressions.
Jordan: Proposed quick patch (pseudo):
```
// in dashboard/metrics_normalizer.go
aliasMap := map[string]string{
  "p95_latency_ms": "latency_ms_p95",
  "median_latency": "latency_ms_median",
}
normalize := func(name string, value float64, unit string) (string, float64){
  canonical := aliasMap[name] || name
  if unit == "s" { value *= 1000; unit = "ms" }
  return canonical, value
}
```
Sam: Sounds good. But we should also fix the source: why is q8_0 slower here? Could be kernel fallback or packing overhead. @Leo can you check NVIDIA driver/kernel logs on worker-3 and worker-7 around the eval timestamps?
Leo: Yep. I'll grep dmesg and the runtime logs. Also will re-run the eval with `--no-prefetch` and `--kv-cache=local` to narrow down.
Anya: One more oddity — the diff panel's 'show delta by route' toggle seems to reset after a page refresh; not sure if that's related but it affects triage speed.
Marta: UI state bug is separate but easy: persist toggle in localStorage. I'll open a tiny PR.
ci-bot: CI /eval-harness #782 — FAILED — test_runner_stability (flaky) :warning:
Sam: Let's gate the dashboard deploy on the CI fix. If the harness runner is flaky we shouldn't roll the dashboard mapping change without clearer signals.
Jordan: I'll create a short-lived feature flag for the normalization change and enable it only for internal orgs while we verify.
Anya: Plan: (1) Leo investigates kernel/driver + re-run with KV tweaks, (2) Jordan lands normalization behind flag + unit tests, (3) Marta fixes toggle persistence, (4) Sam files infra ticket if worker-level kernel fallbacks confirmed.
Sam: +1. Assigning tasks: Leo -> investigate (worker-logs-1785), Jordan -> backend patch + tests, Marta -> UI toggle PR, Anya -> followup triage and keep panel screenshots in thread.
Anya: thanks all, will post results from the re-run in this thread. :thumbsup:
